mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, we are seeing fair conditions near the Military Ridge State Trail. If you look up tonight, you can catch the International Space Station passing over for 6 minutes starting at 5:03 PM, moving from over Verona High School in the northwest toward Fitchburg in the east, reaching about halfway up the sky.

City Hall reminds residents that information packets for the 2027 Spring Election are now available. Also, remember that property tax bills will be arriving in the mail by December 15, and you can pay them through the City Center drop box or online.
It is a busy day for events, with live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's, plus The Crafty Fair at Art House 360. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
In a report from November 2, officers were dispatched to West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
The flavor of the day is the delicious Mint Cookie. The store is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10:30 PM tonight.
